question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become a permanent public plugin-SDK contract after the native-block defect is fixed?
rationale: The Slack delivery defect is mechanical, but permanently expanding the third-party reply-payload API and defining cross-channel progress semantics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the generic marker, document its transient-only semantics and expected channel behavior, and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow to an internal contract
options.body: Preserve the producer-to-Slack typed intent while removing the new exports from the third-party plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic marker, document its transient-only semantics and expected channel behavior, and add focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to the Slack native-data architecture, Codex projection, and the shared public-boundary decision.
